output_policy: Every VCF/JSON byte and complete BAM header/full-record-byte multiset, including duplicate multiplicity. Only BAM record order may differ.
timing_policy: Cache preparation, hashes, warmup, comparison and cleanup are excluded. Archive loading remains timed. No OS page-cache clearing. All application processes run serially on the same inherited CPU mask.

cpu_affinity.reason: No portable CPU pinning on this platform

environment.thread_scope: --threads is compute workers. Codec pools and coordinator roles are additional. A CPU mask limits eligible CPUs, not the number of threads.

8.note: Same allocation/mask; compute workers are not physical-core or total-thread counts.

summary.interpretation: Observed timings/RSS only. Few-pair bootstrap intervals are descriptive, not a hardware-general guarantee. Exit 0 confirms complete measurements and exact outputs, not a speed or memory claim; review the explicit performance fields.

_publication.redaction_note: Workspace prefixes are replaced with <WORKSPACE>; the recorded local hostname is replaced with <LOCAL_HOST>. Original measurements, hashes, equality fields, test output and other values are preserved. Publication metadata is added separately.
_publication.scope: Historical RAMOPT versus v4 only; do not pool with the final v6 comparison.
